question: Which technologies shown at the 1939 fair became part of everyday life, and which predictions failed? Compare across domains.

sections.heading: 자동차와 교통
sections.focus: English: Explore the technologies related to transportation showcased at the fair and their impact on everyday life, including successes and failures.

sections.heading: 미래 도시와 인프라
sections.focus: English: Analyze the urban planning concepts presented at the fair and their relevance to modern city infrastructure, identifying what has been realized and what has not.

sections.heading: 가정과 일상생활
sections.focus: English: Investigate the household technologies introduced at the fair, their adoption in daily life, and the predictions that did not materialize.

sections.heading: 통신·매체와 과학
sections.focus: English: Examine the media technologies and scientific advancements presented at the fair, assessing their integration into society and any failed predictions.

sections.heading: 사회·정치
sections.focus: English: Discuss the societal implications of the fair's themes, including who was included or excluded in the envisioned future, and how these aspects have evolved.

raw_plan.rationale: Korean: The question requires a comprehensive analysis of various domains related to the technologies and predictions made at the 1939 New York World's Fair. Each section focuses on a specific role to provide a detailed examination of the fair's impact across transportation, urban planning, home technologies, media advancements, and societal implications.
